cards.anchor: N1 is already recognized but remains pending through boundary 3. Registration and recognition are independent outputs; six registrations and seven distinct recognitions remain.
cards.burden: The registration clerk performs six one-tick validations. The dispatcher spends six actions, at most one per tick. Roles remain separate; the server processes automatically. Ledger reading adds no clerk labor.
cards.construction: Validate N3,N4,N5,N6,N7,N8 at ticks 0,1,2,3,4,5. Individually request N2,N3,N4,N5,N6 at ticks 0,1,2,3,4; idle at 5; bulk request at 6. Boundary 6 bulk includes only N7,N8.
cards.defeat: Defeat the success claim if the trace yields fewer than eight registrations or recognitions by boundary 9, exceeds six dispatcher actions, requests an unregistered identity, or shows an unintended enqueue or delivery mismatch.
cards.mutation: Use the ordinary individual control while the bulk selection would include recognized or queued identities, then use the ordinary bulk control for the final pair.
cards.prediction_candidate: Predicted first deliveries: N2 through N6 at ticks 1 through 5, N7 at 7, N8 at 8. Eight registrations and eight recognitions by boundary 9; six actions, no duplicates or failures.
cards.prediction_rival: The initial bulk queues recognized N1 before N2. Deliveries shift: N2 through N6 at ticks 2 through 6. Boundary 6 bulk includes N6,N7,N8; duplicate N6 consumes tick 7, N7 succeeds at 8, and N8 remains queued. Eight registrations but seven recognitions by boundary 9.
cards.probe: Trace both schedules at every boundary using registration, recognition, request, queue, dashboard and clock records. Compare pending identities, eligibility, enqueue order, deliveries and distinct outputs through boundary 9. The rival differs only at tick 0, separating the initial bulk selection effect.
cards.rival: Keep the same validation schedule and subsequent requests, but use routine bulk instead of the individual N2 request at tick 0.
unknowns: N1 delay origin is unknown; its fixed clearing boundary establishes no broader defect.
